name: Wings Sailing Charters
summary: Wings Sailing Charters runs a six hour sail, snorkel and paddle board day tour and a two hour sunset sail from Coral Sea Marina in Airlie Beach, both aboard the 60ft sailing catamaran SV Wings III with no more than 29 guests. Private charters on the same boat range from a two hour sunset sail on the bay to overnight trips of several days. Mike and Amy Keyte own and run the business, which has operated in the Whitsundays since 2002.
standouts: Family owned and operated by Mike and Amy Keyte, in the Whitsundays since 2002
Operated for over 20 years as Advanced Eco Tourism operators, as stated on the About page
Day tour and sunset sail limited to 29 guests on SV Wings III, a 60ft custom built sailing catamaran
Private Wings mooring at Langford Island on the day tour

trips.title: Whitsunday Islands Sail, SUP & Snorkel Tour
trips.summary: A six hour day on SV Wings III, a 60ft sailing catamaran, around the northern Hook Island area near Hayman Island. Guests snorkel the fringing reefs, try stand up paddle boards or a clear bottom kayak, or stay on board, and morning tea and lunch are included. It runs with no more than 29 guests.
highlights: Snorkelling on fringing reefs near Hook Island and Hayman Island
Stand up paddle boards and a clear bottom kayak
Private Wings mooring at Langford Island
No more than 29 guests

trips.requirements: Minimum age 5. Guests who cannot swim may not enter the water, and weaker swimmers wear buoyancy aids. Not wheelchair accessible: boarding needs a step across a small gap and two deck steps. The site does not recommend guests over the age of 70.
trips.checkNotes: Adult price, child price and times are on the home page; the tour page shows the adult price and the family prices. Minimum age is 5 in the tour header and the FAQs, but the inclusions list on the tour page says 'Kids welcome 6+'; used 5. The site says a booking fee is added at checkout; the amount is not repeated here. The two Rezdy links share product 499609 (a tracking query string was removed from the second). Meet 8:50am, depart 9:15am, return 3:30pm. The tour does not visit Whitehaven Beach. A snorkel session runs 45 minutes to one hour (FAQs). Weather cancellations on the day are made between 6:30am and 7:30am. The site asks cruise ship guests to check tender times, and a missed tour is not refunded.

checkNotes: Left out as trips: (1) the 6 Day 5 Night, 7 Day 6 Night and 8 Day 7 Night Private Charters. Each has a page, the Extended Charters page marks them 'request availability only', the 7 and 8 day price tables read 'TBC 2026' with no amounts and the 6 day page has no price table. (2) Spa Sunset Sail BBQ on the Bay (3 hours, $2100 for 1 to 9 guests, $2250 for 10 to 19). It is in the site menu, but the Private Charters and Sail on the Bay pages list the 4 hour Premium sail instead, and its wording and sitemap date (January 2023) look older, so it may have been replaced; confirm with the operator. (3) Brunch Sail on the Bay: the menu link redirects to the Sail on the Bay page, which has no brunch trip. (4) The Outer Great Barrier Reef addition is not a separate trip; it is recorded under offers. Not opened (page limit): the Wings I and Wings II fleet pages and the event pages (Family Get Togethers, Birthday Gatherings, Proposals and Romantic Sails, Marry Me on a Catamaran, Hens and Bucks, Couples Elopement, Romantic Getaways, Film and Media Vessel, Specialised Event Charters, Exclusive Charters, Private Cabins). They appear to present the same private charters for events, so no extra trips were made from them; the Private Charters page states event charters suit up to 29 guests on sunset sails, 20 on half and full day charters and 14 on overnight charters. Booking: the day tour and sunset sail are booked online through Rezdy (links recorded, not opened); the day tour availability page embeds a Rezdy calendar for product 499609. Private charters and overnight holidays are enquiry only, with a deposit to secure the date and the balance due four weeks before departure (FAQs). The site says a booking fee is added at checkout for online bookings; the amount is not repeated here. Surcharges for school holidays, public holidays and long weekends are stated on private charter pages with different rates in different places, so none are quoted. Guest-number bands and the number of years in operation also differ between pages; the About page says operating since 2002, which is used. The Awards and Certifications strip in the footer is image-only badges with no text, so no award is claimed. The About page says the business has operated for over 20 years as Advanced Eco Tourism operators. wings.com.au redirects to www.wings.com.au. Phone and email are from the Contact page, which gives the address only as Airlie Beach, QLD 4802; the marina meeting point is from the FAQs. The 'Pre arrival waiver' link goes to a Wherewolf waiver form, not a booking page. Seafood and drink pre-orders go through separate local businesses. The sitemap also lists older pages (day trips, half day small group cruise, Camira Sailing Adventure and ex Port of Airlie tours) that are not linked from the menu; ignored.
